breakpoints.note: First project-code consumption of the attacker-controlled HTML bytes on the reproduced pull-parser path. This statement materializes the fuzzed document fragment into the libxml2 parser context that later drives start-tag and attribute parsing.

Root cause fixed by the patch. After `CUR_CHAR(l)` has already driven the parser into `XML_PARSER_EOF` and `xmlHaltParser()` has rebound `ctxt->input->cur/base/end` to `BAD_CAST ""`, vulnerable code lacks the inserted post-`CUR_CHAR(l)` EOF guard and still advances the cursor with `NEXTL(l)` using the returned `l == 1`.

Crash sink from the saved AddressSanitizer report. After `xmlHaltParser()` resets `ctxt->input->cur/base/end` to the empty-string sentinel and vulnerable `NEXTL(l)` still increments that sentinel cursor by one, the next re-entry to this loop header dereferences `"" + 1`, one byte past the global empty string.
